changelog: FIXES A BUILD THAT WOULD NOT START. 0.0.34 on Android installed and then crashed immediately — the rename moved the app's identity, but the Java class Android launches was left behind in the old package, so the system looked for an activity that wasn't in the file. Nothing in the build noticed: it compiled, signed and installed cleanly. Fixed, and the build now proves the launcher class exists before an APK can ship. If you downloaded 0.0.34 for Android it will not open — install this instead. Desktop 0.0.34 was unaffected. Everything else is as 0.0.34: the game is now Table of War, with a new title plaque and the update feed moved with it. This installs ALONGSIDE any pre-rename copy rather than over it, and starts with a fresh profile.
